While free to premium is a great way to get bottoms-up, often viral traction in an enterprise. Especially for open source, which while not necessarily free/mium, is also affected by these questions.

key_points.text: While free to premium is a great way to get bottoms-up, often viral traction in an enterprise.
And in that case, how does one balance the developer community and desire to "spread the religion" within and beyond the enterprise?

All this and more in this episode of the a16z Podcast with Andreessen Horowitz general partners (who cover all things infrastructure) Martin Casado and Peter Levine and Go-to-Market and EBC operating head Mark Cranney..
